message.xenowarriors.rhalix.too_hungry: Rhalix is too hungry to fly...
skill.xenowarriors.dance_kick.desc: Komatsu Norio's signature move, learned through True Empathy: a disco spin up into the air that kicks everyone around him away, then a flying finisher into whoever he's aiming at.
skill.xenowarriors.netsu_burst.desc: Everything into one burst of speed: he blasts forward in a line of fire through everyone in the way. With Netsu burning it hits twice as hard but uses the Netsu up. He's winded for a moment after.
skill.xenowarriors.manifest_greatness.de: He chants "Manifest... True... Greatness!" and, believing it, glows red: Strength II, Speed, Resistance and faster Karma for 30 seconds.
skill.xenowarriors.true_empathy.desc: He feels what someone just did and does it himself: copies the last skill anyone used near him (within 20 seconds, never an ultimate). Nothing to copy? He reads the next attack instead - dodges it and hits back harder. Overuse it (3 times in 90 seconds) and he starts losing himself: weak, slow and dizzy.
skill.xenowarriors.ka_release.desc: Rhalix breaks free of whatever holds him - roots, gravity, slows, poisons, every harmful effect and every KA - with a burst that throws enemies back. For 4 seconds nothing can hold him again. It costs as much Karma as the enemy spent on the KA that hit him.
skill.xenowarriors.hekublade_scatter.des: Copies of the Hekublade appear in the air around Mikiko, pointing wherever he looks. Each blade hits hard and can clash with enemy blasts.
skill.xenowarriors.kitsune.desc: Kitsune Attack: Tier 3. He blurs through the target in a streak of fox-fire and lands behind them while a flurry of bone-cracking blows hits. Broken bones leave them badly slowed and weakened.
skill.xenowarriors.netsu.desc: Mikiko burns hot: +90% speed, more attack, attack speed and armor, and anything that touches him burns. It drains his health while it lasts, and the more Defense he has, the longer it lasts.
skill.xenowarriors.fire_blitz.desc: He cups a ball of fire and throws it. It sticks to whoever it hits, keeps them burning for 12 seconds, and lets him see them through walls. Clashes with enemy blasts.
skill.xenowarriors.kishi.desc: Slams a gravity dome down on whoever you aim at (or the spot you look at). Nobody inside can jump, and it pins them in place.
skill.xenowarriors.earth_wave.desc: He stomps and a big wave of earth rolls out wherever he's looking, damaging and launching everything in its path.
skill.xenowarriors.gravity_compress.desc: Traps the target in a gravity sphere that closes in and crushes them. They can't move until it implodes. Clashes with enemy blasts.
skill.xenowarriors.bang.desc: He points a finger like a gun and fires a bullet of earth. Tiny cooldown, a little Karma per shot. Clashes with enemy blasts.
skill.xenowarriors.hekublade_scatter.how: Press to summon 6 blades. Press again to fire one at your target (each press fires the next). Leftovers fire on their own after 8 seconds.
skill.xenowarriors.kitsune.how: Aim at a target and press. Best up close.
skill.xenowarriors.netsu.how: Press to ignite, press again to put it out early. Combine with Netsu Burst for an all-out attack.
skill.xenowarriors.fire_blitz.how: Aim and press. Fire it at an enemy charging an element blast to start a clash.
skill.xenowarriors.blazing_wind.desc: Mikiko's ultimate (cutscene): a giant fire tornado that drags in and burns everything nearby.
skill.xenowarriors.blazing_wind.how: Press the ultimate key. Sneak + ultimate near Rhalix in your party for the team attack.
skill.xenowarriors.dance_kick.how: Press near enemies; aim at the one you want the finisher to hit.
skill.xenowarriors.netsu_burst.how: Face where you want to go and press. Turn Netsu on first for the all-out version.
skill.xenowarriors.manifest_greatness.ho: Press when you're safe for 1.5 seconds - you're slowed while you chant.
skill.xenowarriors.true_empathy.how: Press right after an enemy or ally uses a skill nearby, or before an enemy attacks you.
skill.xenowarriors.kishi.how: Press to cast. Press again while it's active to make the gravity heavier (up to level 3).
skill.xenowarriors.earth_wave.how: Stand on the ground, face your enemies and press.
skill.xenowarriors.gravity_compress.how: Aim at a target and press.
skill.xenowarriors.bang.how: Tap as fast as you like while aiming.
skill.xenowarriors.gravity_barrage.desc: Rhalix's ultimate (cutscene): a storm of gravity that crushes everything around the target.
skill.xenowarriors.gravity_barrage.how: Press the ultimate key. Sneak + ultimate near Mikiko in your party for the team attack.
skill.xenowarriors.ka_release.how: Press while bound, slowed or hit by a KA. Works even while pinned.
ka.xenowarriors.weight.does: Your armor turns heavy: slowed hard, can't jump, and you drop out of the air.
ka.xenowarriors.grip.does: The ground loses its friction for you: you slide around and can't stop.
ka.xenowarriors.stride.does: They cover the distance in one step, appear next to you and hit you, pulling you in.
ka.xenowarriors.hold.does: Your hands open: whatever you're holding drops to the ground.
ka.xenowarriors.reach.does: Their hits land from 6 blocks away for a few seconds.
ka.xenowarriors.pace.does: Your movement and swing speed drop way down for a few seconds.
ka.xenowarriors.sight.does: Your camera locks onto them - you can't look away.
ka.xenowarriors.delay.does: Your attacks land 2 seconds late while theirs land instantly.
ka.xenowarriors.mirror.does: For a few seconds, attacks and projectiles bounce back at whoever used them.
ka.xenowarriors.tether.does: Links you to them: whatever damage they take, you take too.
ka.xenowarriors.flip.does: Your controls flip - left is right, forward is back - for a few seconds.
ka.xenowarriors.memory.does: Your hotbar gets shuffled (mobs forget who they were fighting).
ka.xenowarriors.swap.does: They swap places with you in an instant.
ka.xenowarriors.bind.does: You freeze in place, struggling, until you break free or someone hits them.
element.xenowarriors.water.does: A water whip that knocks you back and puts out fire.
element.xenowarriors.earth.does: Rock spikes erupt where you stand after a rumble - move!
element.xenowarriors.ice.does: Frost shards that slow and freeze you.
element.xenowarriors.lightning.does: A bolt that jumps to up to two more targets.
element.xenowarriors.wind.does: A gust that throws you back and up.
element.xenowarriors.sound.does: A sonic blast that dazes you.
element.xenowarriors.light.does: A blinding flash and a beam of light.
element.xenowarriors.crystal.does: Three crystal shards, and a crystal shield for the caster.
element.xenowarriors.cloud.does: Fog that blinds and slows everyone in it.
element.xenowarriors.plant.does: Vines hold you in place; nearby allies get healed.
element.xenowarriors.metal.does: Steel blades; the caster's skin hardens.
element.xenowarriors.smoke.does: Vanishes in smoke and reappears behind you.
element.xenowarriors.shadow.does: Dark tendrils that slow you - sometimes they rise up behind you.
element.xenowarriors.corruption.does: Purple bolts that drain your Karma and wither you.
element.xenowarriors.poison.does: A poison cloud where you stand.
element.xenowarriors.void.does: A little black hole that drags you in.
character.xenowarriors.ultima.title: The Ultimate Weapon
skill.xenowarriors.attack_prediction.des: His chip reads their habits, fear and heartbeat: the next 2 hits (+1 per output step) are dodged and countered. At 25% output (hands in his pockets) it also reads a hit now and then on its own.
skill.xenowarriors.energy_blast.desc: Green energy. 25%: one blast. 45%: a burst of three. 70%: one big piercing blast. 100%: a barrage of six. Clashes with enemy blasts.
skill.xenowarriors.energy_blast.how: Aim and press. Cheap and fast.
skill.xenowarriors.living_weapon.desc: His whole body is a weapon: for 10 seconds his blows land heavy and hit everyone around the target too. Resistance as well from 70% output.
skill.xenowarriors.output_surge.desc: Pushes his output up one step right now (25 > 45 > 70 > 100%) instead of waiting for it to ramp up. 25%: lazy kicks, hands in pockets. 45%: flight and blast bursts. 70%: heavy combos - every third blow is a slam. 100%: everything at max.
skill.xenowarriors.output_surge.how: Press when you need more power fast.
skill.xenowarriors.full_output_beam.desc: Ultima's ultimate: a second of charging, then a huge green beam that tears through everything in a line. Bigger and stronger with every output step - strongest in Overload.
skill.xenowarriors.full_output_beam.how: Press the ultimate key and aim.
skill.xenowarriors.moon_reflect.desc: Lunar Form only. A silver crescent mirror wraps around Rhalix for 5 seconds: arrows and blasts fly back at whoever threw them, and half of every blow is turned back on the attacker.
skill.xenowarriors.moon_reflect.how: Press in Lunar Form (at night), right before they hit you.
skill.xenowarriors.moon_fall.desc: Lunar Form super move. Rhalix raises a hand and a moon falls on the spot he's looking at, then bursts in a huge silver blast. Doesn't break blocks.
skill.xenowarriors.moon_fall.how: Ctrl+6 in Lunar Form. Sneak + Ctrl+6 still uses a test KA.
character.xenowarriors.kaeru.title: Guardian of the Hekublade
skill.xenowarriors.sound_burst.desc: A blast of sound in front of her: damages, knocks back, slows and dizzies everything in the cone.
skill.xenowarriors.hekubarrier.desc: A spinning ring of Hekublade energy around her for 7 seconds: projectiles break on it, enemies are pushed out, and she takes less damage. Not while Mikiko is holding the blade.
skill.xenowarriors.fox_heal.desc: Revives a knocked-out party member right away. If nobody is down, heals the most hurt teammate nearby for 60% of their health.
skill.xenowarriors.fox_heal.how: Press near a downed or hurt teammate.
skill.xenowarriors.scent_track.desc: She catches the scent of what she's looking at (or the closest threat within 64 blocks): it glows through walls for 45 seconds.
skill.xenowarriors.scent_track.how: Look at a target and press, or just press.
skill.xenowarriors.hekubeats_finale.desc: Kaeru's ultimate: four huge pulses of sound, each one bigger and stronger than the last.
skill.xenowarriors.soul_splitter.desc: Splits your soul off to fight beside you. Your health, damage and Karma (and Ki with DragonMineZ) are divided while it's out. Mikiko holds it longest and gets 2 souls at Soul Splitter level 15 and 3 at level 40. Rhalix's soul uses gravity at level 10 and wires at level 25. Go more than 48 blocks away and the soul finds its way back. Kaeru in the Hekublade casts herself out instead.
skill.xenowarriors.soul_splitter.how: Press to split, press again to call it back.
character.xenowarriors.kyrie.title: The Royal Capital's Loving Queen
character.xenowarriors.lexy.title: The Freakishly Strong
character.xenowarriors.max.title: The Slacker of C3
character.xenowarriors.sam.title: The Knucklehead
skill.xenowarriors.rapier_thrust.desc: A lunging rapier thrust that runs her through everything in a line.
skill.xenowarriors.rapier_thrust.how: Press and aim where to lunge.
skill.xenowarriors.gravity_fetch.desc: Gravity pulls what she's looking at straight to her - and every dropped item within 16 blocks.
skill.xenowarriors.gravity_fetch.how: Look at a target (or just press near loot).
skill.xenowarriors.bullet_stop.desc: A gravity field around her for 6 seconds: arrows and blasts stop dead in the air, then drop.
skill.xenowarriors.boxing_stance.desc: The stance she copied from Rhalix: for 12 seconds her own blows hit 60% harder and she moves quicker.
skill.xenowarriors.no_milk.desc: The Queen's punishment: the target is locked in a gravity cell for 6 seconds - can't move, can't jump, weak.
skill.xenowarriors.no_milk.how: Look at the offender and press.
skill.xenowarriors.royal_gravity.desc: Kyrie's ultimate: everything around her is lifted into the air, then slammed back down.
skill.xenowarriors.freak_punch.desc: One punch with all her freakish strength: big damage and sends them flying.
skill.xenowarriors.table_breaker.desc: She leaps and smashes the ground: a shockwave throws everything nearby into the air.
skill.xenowarriors.karma_surge.desc: Her Karma is off the charts: refills 45 of her own and gives 20 to each party member nearby. Costs no Karma.
skill.xenowarriors.wing_rush.desc: A wing-powered charge that slams into everything in her way.
skill.xenowarriors.iron_grip.desc: Grabs the target and crushes them for 2 seconds, then throws them.
skill.xenowarriors.persephone.desc: Lexy's ultimate: Persephone takes over for 20 seconds - 80% stronger, tougher and faster. Lexy is drained afterwards.
skill.xenowarriors.dagger_flurry.desc: Five quick dagger stabs on one target.
skill.xenowarriors.wind_of_sorrow.desc: He rides the wind in a burst, shoving aside everything in the way.
skill.xenowarriors.wind_wall.desc: A wall of wind spins round him for 6 seconds and blows arrows and blasts back at whoever shot them.
skill.xenowarriors.lunar_mind.desc: The Lunar path: at night he sinks into his mind state - stronger, faster and healing for 20 seconds. Weaker by day.
skill.xenowarriors.rapid_vampire_slice.d: A storm of slashes that drink the target's blood back into him.
skill.xenowarriors.moonlit_gale.desc: Max's ultimate: a cyclone of wind blades whirls round him for 4 seconds (stronger at night).
skill.xenowarriors.batter_up.desc: A full swing of his bat that sends them flying.
skill.xenowarriors.clear_space.desc: His rare element: he blinks straight to whoever he's looking at (up to 32 blocks). Sneak to pull THEM in front of him instead.
skill.xenowarriors.clear_space.how: Look at someone and press (sneak to pull).
skill.xenowarriors.ticking_time_bomb.des: A bat strike that plants a bomb in the target - it goes off 10 seconds later.
skill.xenowarriors.ticking_time_bomb.how: Press up close, then keep away.
skill.xenowarriors.knockout_mode.desc: For 15 seconds his bat can't finish anyone: a blow that would knocks them out cold instead.
skill.xenowarriors.knockout_mode.how: Press when you need them alive.
skill.xenowarriors.batter_shoot.desc: Two swings, then one that sends them flying - and sets off a planted bomb early, 50% harder.
skill.xenowarriors.batter_shoot.how: Plant a bomb first, then press.
skill.xenowarriors.psychotic_time_bomb.d: Sam's ultimate: plants bombs in every enemy within 12 blocks. They all go off 5 seconds later.
skill.xenowarriors.psychotic_time_bomb.h: Press the ultimate key in a crowd.
character.xenowarriors.aioni.title: The Demon Teacher
character.xenowarriors.technica.title: The Tech Genius
skill.xenowarriors.explosive_rounds.desc: A burst from both Uzis - the last rounds explode.
skill.xenowarriors.gravity_rounds.desc: Rounds that copy Kyrie's gravity: every hit shoves the target back.
skill.xenowarriors.gravity_boots.desc: 10 seconds of faster moves, higher jumps, soft landings and harder kicks.
skill.xenowarriors.gravity_boots.how: Press before a fight or a climb.
skill.xenowarriors.visor_scan.desc: Her visor tracks movement: everything within 40 blocks glows for 15 seconds, and it reads the health of what she looks at.
skill.xenowarriors.rescue_platform.desc: Her watch calls the rescue platform: party members within 48 blocks are pulled to her, healed and floating safely.
skill.xenowarriors.rescue_platform.how: Press when the team is in trouble.
skill.xenowarriors.tech_barrage.desc: Technica's ultimate: four seconds of non-stop Uzi fire into everything in front of her, explosive and gravity rounds mixed.
skill.xenowarriors.tech_barrage.how: Press the ultimate key and aim.
skill.xenowarriors.cloak_device.desc: One of her inventions: she turns invisible for 12 seconds.
character.xenowarriors.stevie.title: The Human Calculator
character.xenowarriors.garry.title: The Smarter Brother
skill.xenowarriors.karma_blast.desc: A blast of raw karma at what they're looking at.
skill.xenowarriors.war_cry.desc: "RARRRR!!!" - stronger and tougher for 12 seconds, and enemies close by flinch.
skill.xenowarriors.good_karma.desc: A strike so full of good karma it knocks the target out of their form: every buff on them is gone.
skill.xenowarriors.disco_kick.desc: A spinning dance kick that hits everything around.
skill.xenowarriors.body_slam.desc: Garry jumps on the target and slams them into the ground.
skill.xenowarriors.body_slam.how: Look at a target and press.
skill.xenowarriors.freestyle_bars.desc: He drops some bars: party members nearby get faster and get Karma back.
skill.xenowarriors.bar_thief.desc: Stevie steals his brother's bars: copies a good effect from someone nearby onto himself.
skill.xenowarriors.brother_blast.desc: The ultimate: a huge karma blast in a line - much stronger with the other brother in your party.
skill.xenowarriors.brother_blast.how: Press the ultimate key and aim.
